story.title: Dear Earth
paragraphs_en: I heard Mummy saying the other day that we need to save Planet Earth. So I thought I would write to you and ask if you are well.
I know you have a fever – the atmosphere is now much warmer because of climate change.
Our class teacher Payal Miss told us it’s because we are cutting down forests and building houses and factories or digging mines.
Does that mean animals are losing their homes as well?
We are also driving too many cars and aeroplanes which are sending carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.

She said that it’s bleaching coral reefs, just like we put bleach in our clothes to make them white. I first thought it was a good thing, but then I understood it means that they are under stress, just like when Mummy is when she has a deadline at work. Only coral reefs are stressed because of rising sea water temperatures and pollution.
That’s the new word I learned in class today – Pollution. It seems all the trash we are throwing out is ending up in huge landfills.
We are also polluting the air, and people in some countries are using masks to breathe!
Fish and sharks and dolphins are also unhappy because of all the water pollution.
I just wanted to tell you Get Well Soon. I even made you a card, Mummy said you will like it.
When I have a cough and fever, my Mummy tucks me into bed with my favourite octopus toy.
I am going to tuck this letter with a mango seed. (Mangoes are really yummy, but I ate this one up, so you only get the seed. I hope you don’t mind.)
Feel better soon. Big hug. Love Meenu

items.text_en: Dear Earth, How are you?
I heard Mummy saying the other day that we need to save Planet Earth.
So I thought I would write to you and ask if you are well.
I know you have a fever – the atmosphere is now much warmer because of climate change.
Our class teacher Payal Miss told us it’s because we are cutting down forests and building houses and factories or digging mines.
Does that mean animals are losing their homes as well?
We are also driving too many cars and aeroplanes which are sending carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
She said that it’s bleaching coral reefs, just like we put bleach in our clothes to make them white.
I first thought it was a good thing, but then I understood it means that they are under stress, just like when Mummy is when she has a deadline at work.
Only coral reefs are stressed because of rising sea water temperatures and pollution.
That’s the new word I learned in class today – Pollution.
It seems all the trash we are throwing out is ending up in huge landfills.
We are also polluting the air, and people in some countries are using masks to breathe!
Fish and sharks and dolphins are also unhappy because of all the water pollution.
I just wanted to tell you Get Well Soon.
I even made you a card, Mummy said you will like it.
When I have a cough and fever, my Mummy tucks me into bed with my favourite octopus toy.
I am going to tuck this letter with a mango seed.
(Mangoes are really yummy, but I ate this one up, so you only get the seed.
I hope you don’t mind.)
Feel better soon.
Big hug. Love Meenu
